about: The Art desk's answers for the mounts that name no host by id, or a host by a slip (INPUT-2026-10-02 5.5 and 6.1 to 6.4; O3 amendment 1, 4.6). KeySceneImport reads each by the piece's id and its mount words as the package writes them, so a new wording still refuses. The table retires when CD's next issue names every host by id (the Art desk 7).

hosts.answer: the Art desk 5.5: building.stp_cannery is a slip for structure.stp_cannery. Hosted for sorting only: no anchor comes with StPetersCannery, so it keeps its own numbers, (174.38, 11.62) at +15.30 on the ridge.
